info.title: Lawyer advertising rules by state (50 states and DC): data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Lawyer advertising rules by state (50 states and DC): The lawyer advertising rules of every US state and DC, in plain English: ad filing, what each ad must include, waiting periods for injury contact, claims and testimonials, referral and lead rules, ads in other languages, call-recording consent, texting law and privacy law, plus state laws on drug and medical-device ads. Each cell cites its official source with the words quoted, and says how it was checked (P, D or U).

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
